description: Edit the body content of one or more mnemon entries. Each item carries an entryId and an ordered list of ops (append, insertAfter, replace, remove) applied atomically per entry. Op content is authored as Markdown (headings, lists, quotes, code fences, bold/italic, links) — do NOT send HTML. Mentions: @[label](mnemon:<entryId>). Images: ![caption](asset:<assetId>@<campaignId>) — upload the asset first; inline base64 / data: URLs are not accepted. Node addressing: get body-node ids from get_mnemon, then target them in replace/remove/insertAfter. A single op's Markdown may produce several nodes; new nodes get fresh server-generated ids (replace keeps the original id on the first new node). On a bad op (missing blockId, unknown op, etc.) the whole entry's batch is rejected with the failedOpIndex; no partial mutation per entry. See describe_mnemon_types.blockOps for the full vocabulary.

entryId.description: Mnemon entry id (hex) or exact title.

ops.description: Ordered ops to apply atomically per entry.

items.description: A single body mutation, keyed by node id. See describe_mnemon_types.blockOps.

afterBlockId.description: Required for insertAfter: the body node id the new content follows.

blockId.description: Required for replace and remove: a body node id from get_mnemon.

markdown.description: Markdown content for append / insertAfter / replace. May produce several body nodes. Mentions: @[label](mnemon:<entryId>); images: ![caption](asset:<assetId>@<campaignId>).
